import unittest
from audit import record

class Audit(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fresh_calls(self):
        a = record('opened')
        b = record('closed')
        self.assertEqual(a, ['opened'])
        self.assertEqual(b, ['closed'])
        self.assertIsNot(a, b)
    def test_copy_and_duplicates(self):
        original = ['ping']
        self.assertEqual(record('ping', original), ['ping','ping'])
        self.assertEqual(original, ['ping'])
        empty = []
        self.assertEqual(record('start', empty), ['start'])
        self.assertEqual(empty, [])
        self.assertEqual(record('x', None), ['x'])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
